signals.content: AI Agent to learn based on retrieved context media such as documents, files, media and links
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; retrieval/RAG relevance. Final score: 67. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: Emil57/document-intelligence-rag
Brief: An AI agent designed to ingest and learn from retrieved contextual media—including documents, files, multimedia, and hyperlinks. It employs retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) to dynamically incorporate external information, enabling up‑to‑date, source‑grounded responses. The system is intended for OSINT and strategic analysis, emphasizing verifiable evidence while acknowledging gaps or uncertainties in the source material.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: Emil57/document-intelligence-rag
الملخص: وكيل ذكاء اصطناعي مُصمم لامتصاص وتعلم المعلومات من وسائط سياقية مسترجعة، تشمل المستندات، الملفات، الوسائط المتعددة والروابط. يستخدم تقنية الاسترجاع مع التوليد (RAG) لدمج المعلومات الخارجية بشكل ديناميكي، ما يتيح ردوداً محدثة ومُستندة إلى المصدر. يُستهدف النظام التحليل الاستراتيجي وجمع المعلومات المفتوحة (OSINT)، مع التركيز على الأدلة القابلة للتحقق وإبقاء الشكوك أو الفجوات في البيانات واضحة.

signals.brief_en:
Title: Retsumdk/Retsumdk
Role: AI Agent Infrastructure Expert – Building the future of autonomous AI systems.
Brief: The subject specializes in designing, deploying, and scaling modular AI agent architectures that operate with minimal human oversight. Core competencies include distributed orchestration, secure data pipelines, and adaptive learning loops. Current projects focus on integrating LLMs with edge compute nodes to enable real‑time decision‑making in constrained environments. Risks involve model drift, supply‑chain vulnerabilities, and regulatory compliance gaps. Monitoring recommendations: track model performance metrics, audit data provenance, and maintain redundancy in compute resources.

signals.title: mustafa-omeri/goku-dev-skills
signals.content: Turn AI coding agents (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code) into senior engineers: 30+ battle-tested skills, 11 deterministic quality gates & zero AI-slop.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: mustafa-omeri/goku-dev-skills

Objective: Convert AI coding agents (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code) into senior‑level engineers.

Key Points:
- 30+ battle‑tested development skills covering architecture, testing, security, performance, and DevOps.
- 11 deterministic quality gates (code style, static analysis, unit/integration test coverage, security scan, performance benchmark, documentation, CI/CD validation, rollback plan, peer review, compliance check) to enforce consistent output.
- Zero "AI‑slop": agents must produce production‑ready code without placeholder comments or speculative implementations.
- OSINT‑style monitoring: continuous data collection on agent performance, error rates, and client feedback to refine skill set.
- Strategic impact: reduces senior engineer workload, accelerates delivery cycles, and improves code reliability across projects.

Caveats: Effectiveness depends on prompt engineering, domain data quality, and ongoing human oversight. Results may vary across programming languages and legacy codebases.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: mustafa-omeri/goku-dev-skills

الهدف: تحويل وكلاء البرمجة الذكائيين (Antigravity، Cursor، Claude Code) إلى مهندسين من المستوى senior.

النقاط الرئيسية:
- أكثر من 30 مهارة تم اختبارها ميدانياً تشمل الهندسة المعمارية، الاختبار، الأمن، الأداء، وDevOps.
- 11 بوابة جودة حتمية (نمط الكود، التحليل الساكن، تغطية الاختبارات الوحدوية/التكاملية، فحص الأمان، معيار الأداء، التوثيق، التحقق من CI/CD، خطة الاسترجاع، مراجعة الأقران، فحص الامتثال) لضمان مخرجات ثابتة.
- لا وجود لـ "AI‑slop": يجب على الوكلاء إنتاج كود جاهز للإنتاج دون تعليقات نائبة أو تنفيذات تخمينية.
- منهجية OSINT: جمع مستمر للبيانات حول أداء الوكلاء، معدلات الأخطاء، وردود العملاء لتحديث مجموعة المهارات.
- الأثر الاستراتيجي: يقلل العبء عن المهندسين senior، يسرّع دورات التسليم، ويحسّن موثوقية الكود عبر المشاريع.

التحذيرات: تعتمد الفعالية على صياغة الأوامر، جودة بيانات المجال، وإشراف بشري مستمر. قد تختلف النتائج حسب لغات البرمجة وقواعد الشيفرة القديمة.

Title: mainza-ai/kubona
Open‑source platform enabling autonomous AI agents to perform quantum‑computing experiments and scientific discovery. signals.title: SourceShift/mini-ork
signals.content: Prove an AI-written fix actually fixes the bug. mini-ork certify reproduces the bug against your repo's own code, attacks the patch with generated invariants in a Docker sandbox, and returns PROVEN / REFUTED / UNVERIFIED with a JSON certificate. Part of a verifier-gated, multi-model agent runtime.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; model capability relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en: SourceShift/mini-ork is an OSINT‑style AI verification tool that demonstrates whether an AI‑generated fix truly resolves a reported bug. It reproduces the bug in the target repository, subjects the patch to automatically generated invariants inside a Docker sandbox, and issues a concise certificate stating PROVEN, REFUTED, or UNVERIFIED. The system operates as a verifier‑gated, multi‑model agent runtime, providing strategic, evidence‑based assurance without overstating confidence.

signals.content: A new way to measure how AI agents handle the routine analyses of wet-lab science—BioBasicsBench. Developed with Ligo, a biotech company focused on enzyme design, the benchmark draws on 100 tasks from real experiments to test whether agents can interpret raw lab data, identify errors, and recognize when the evidence doesn’t support a conclusion. Accelerating biological research starts with getting the everyday work right. BioBasicsBench shows where models need to improve, and helps us track what those gains mean for scientific progress, biosafety, and biosecurity. https://t.co/wN2xLk0YeW
